results.rule_description: Minimum wall thickness >= 1.5mm for CNC milled parts
results.observation: The part consists of solid cylindrical shafts and a thick circular web. No thin walls or fragile features are visible.

results.rule_description: Pocket depth-to-width ratio should not exceed 4:1
results.observation: There are no pockets, slots, or cavities in the part geometry.

results.rule_description: Avoid undercuts and features inaccessible to standard 3-axis end mills
results.observation: All features (shafts and web) are accessible from the top or bottom directions. There are no undercuts or inaccessible overhangs.

results.rule_description: Hole depth-to-diameter ratio should not exceed 10:1 for standard drills
results.observation: There are no holes visible in the part geometry.

results.rule_description: Avoid thin ribs and webs (< 2mm thick at depth > 4x thickness)
results.observation: The web is a thick solid disk, and there are no thin ribs or fins.

results.rule_description: All edges should be accessible for deburring operations
results.observation: All edges are external and easily accessible for deburring tools.

results.rule_description: Tapped hole thread depth >= 1.5x nominal bolt diameter
results.observation: There are no tapped holes in the part.

results.rule_description: All features must have adequate clearance for manufacturing tool access
results.observation: The part is completely open and all surfaces can be reached by standard milling tools from the top or bottom setups.

results.rule_description: Prefer symmetric features to reduce setup operations and fixturing complexity
results.observation: The part requires an offset crankpin for its function, so it cannot be fully symmetric. However, the design is as simple as possible for its function.

results.rule_description: Horizontal holes should use a teardrop profile to prevent sagging at the top of the hole.
results.observation: There are no horizontal holes in the part.

results.rule_description: Functional protrusions attached to thin walls should have fillets or ribs to distribute stress and prevent layer delamination.
results.observation: There are no thin walls in the part.

results.rule_description: Lids and mating enclosures should have alignment features such as a lip, flange, or pins to ensure proper registration.
results.observation: The part is not a lid or mating enclosure.

results.rule_description: Sharp internal corners should be filleted to reduce stress concentrations and prevent cracking.
results.observation: The intersections where the main shaft and crankpin meet the circular web are perfectly sharp 90-degree internal corners.
results.recommendation: Add a fillet at the base of the main shaft and crankpin where they meet the web to reduce stress concentrations.

results.rule_description: Hinge knuckles must have rounded profiles concentric with the pivot pin to allow rotation without collision.
results.observation: The part does not contain hinge knuckles.

results.rule_description: Lids and doors should have a handle, tab, or indentation to facilitate user opening.
results.observation: The part is not a lid or door.

results.rule_description: Sharp external edges should be chamfered or filleted for handling safety and to reduce chipping.
results.observation: The outer perimeter of the circular web and the ends of the shafts have sharp 90-degree external edges.
results.recommendation: Add chamfers or fillets to all sharp external edges for safety and to prevent chipping.

results.rule_description: Internal vertical corners must have a minimum radius to accommodate the cylindrical shape of an end mill.
results.observation: There are no internal vertical corners in pockets or cavities.

results.rule_description: Holes intended for pin or shaft insertion should have a chamfered lead-in to facilitate assembly.
results.observation: There are no holes intended for pin insertion.

results.rule_description: Turned parts should be rotationally symmetric; non-symmetric features require secondary milling operations.
results.observation: The part is a crankshaft and inherently requires an offset crankpin, making it non-rotationally symmetric. However, the specified manufacturing process is CNC milling, not turning.

results.rule_description: Cylindrical pins intended for floating assembly should have retaining ring grooves or other axial retention features.
results.observation: The crankpin and main shaft are smooth cylinders with no retaining ring grooves or threaded ends for axial retention.
results.recommendation: Add retaining ring grooves or threaded ends to the shafts for axial retention of mating components like bearings or connecting rods.

results.rule_description: Closed-loop bearing holes intended for assembly over captive shafts must be split into two pieces with fastening features.
results.observation: The part is a shaft, not a bearing hole.

results.rule_description: Pistons must have circumferential ring grooves for sealing.
results.observation: The part is not a piston.

results.rule_description: Thin-walled turned parts should have sufficient thickness to prevent deformation during machining.
results.observation: The part is not thin-walled.

results.rule_description: Pins and shafts intended for insertion into holes should have chamfered or radiused ends to facilitate assembly and prevent binding.
results.observation: The ends of the main shaft and crankpin have perfectly sharp 90-degree edges.
results.recommendation: Add chamfers to the ends of the main shaft and crankpin to facilitate assembly into bearings or mating parts.

results.rule_description: Connecting rod beams should taper from the big end to the small end to optimize stress distribution.
results.observation: The part is not a connecting rod.

proposed_rules.pass_criteria: Web has additional mass (counterweight) opposite the crankpin.
proposed_rules.look_for: Mass distribution on the crank web relative to the crankpin.
proposed_rules.description: Crankshaft webs should incorporate counterweights opposite the crankpin to balance rotational inertia.
proposed_rules.fail_criteria: Web is a simple centered disk with no counterbalancing mass.
